notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/geo-block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (User-agent: * / Allow: /). Denmark market/locale is /da/ (confirmed via serverCultures culture=da-DK, market=DK in page state; sostrenegrene.com/ without a locale defaults to /en-gb/). Site is an Umbraco-headless SPA: the product grid is entirely client-rendered (initial HTML/WebFetch only ever shows 'productIds':[] placeholders), so counts were NOT scraped from rendered text but from the site's own backend API discovered by reading the main JS bundle (assets.sostrenegrene.com/client/dist/assets/main-*.js): GET /umbraco/api/catalog/search?categoryId=<id>&pageSize=<n> returns {"total":N,...}. Category IDs were read from each category page's embedded jsonContent.content.categoryId (NOT the c-NNNN slug suffix, which is an unrelated CMS contentId). IMPORTANT qty-verification finding: querying this endpoint with pageSize=1 (the cheap default) gave visibly non-deterministic totals on repeat identical requests (e.g. Vaser og potter/Vases and pots swung 107/116/130 across calls) -- classic 'measured unreliable, never trust unchecked' per Rule 1. Re-tested with pageSize=500 (covers every category's true size) and 3x repeat verification per category: this stabilized 11 of 12 leaf categories to a single reproducible number both within a session and across two independent fresh sessions. One category (Vaser og potter) remained genuinely split between two internally-consistent-but-different values (107 in one session, 116 in another; each stable 3/3 within its own session) -- read as backend-replica/search-index desync behind the site's ARRAffinity load balancer, not resolvable from outside, so left qty null + flagged rather than guessed. All other qtys below were reproduced 3-5x. Rule 0 gains: mirrors (Spejle) and lamps/string-lights/lanterns (Lamper) counted as their own leaf categories per Rule 0.1/0.3 despite living inside the generic 'Interior' branch; a handful of items (0-1 per leaf) not matching the leaf's own label leak into raw listings at high pageSize (e.g. 1 LED bulb inside Lamper) but were not worth stripping out of an otherwise-clean, correctly-scoped category (mixed-rollup guidance applied at the whole-node level, not line-by-line). Site's own root nav (Interior>Lys, a single rolled-up candles node, contentId 8327/categoryId 125, ~149 items mixing scented+unscented) duplicates the more granular top-level 'Lys' (Candles) branch which splits cleanly into Tealight/Block/Taper/Outdoor/Scented candles by categoryId -- used the granular split instead per Rule 0.6 and dropped the rolled-up duplicate node so scented candles could be excluded cleanly. Rule 0.6 room tree: site also has a parallel 'Rum' (Rooms) nav (Stue/Soveværelse/Køkken/Børneværelse/Badeværelse/Kontor/Entré/Spisestue/Have og altan) queryable via roomId (e.g. roomId=livingroom -> total 697); sampled and confirmed this is a cross-category 'shop the room' re-slice of the SAME base catalog (product IDs already counted under the type tree) heavily dominated by furniture and textiles (both out of scope) -- treated as a re-cut/duplicate of already-extracted product IDs and not emitted as separate rows, per Rule 0.6's duplicate-listing exception. Excluded entirely after inspection of actual product titles: Opbevaring/Storage, Kurve/Baskets, Kunstige blomster/Artificial flowers, Puslespil og spil/Puzzles and games (all under Interior); Tekstiler/Textiles (rugs, cushions, towels, kitchen textiles); Møbler/Furniture; Bøger/Books; Elektronik/Electronics (checked -- only batteries, a phone case, and a kids' LED drawing pad, no genuine home lighting); Have/Garden (checked -- entirely growing/planting supplies: seeds, gloves, tools, grow-pots, no decor); Køkkenudstyr's Bageartikler/Baking, Rengøring/Cleaning, Køkkentilbehør/Kitchen accessories (checked -- utensils/storage, negligible tableware bleed not worth padding for); Badeværelsestilbehør/Bathroom accessories (checked -- dominated by toilet brushes, soap dispensers, laundry baskets, towels, storage furniture; the few mirrors/hooks inside it duplicate product IDs already counted under the dedicated Spejle/Mirrors category, so not double-counted); Duftlys/Scented candles under Lys; all of Mad og drikke/Food and drink, Kreativitet/Hobby craft supplies, Fest/Party, Kontorartikler/Stationery, Børn/Children (toys, dress-up, kids' crafts, bath -- no kids'-room decor node found), Accessories (jewelry/hair/clothing), Jul/Christmas, Påske/Easter (Holiday & Gift). No dedicated clock ('ur') category or products found anywhere on the site (checked site search and Electronics) -- Sostrene Grene DK does not appear to sell wall/table clocks as a listed category.
